Question 13

Let f(x,y)=2xy. Find the linear approximation of f at the point (2,8).

a
f(x,y)≈2x+y2
b
f(x,y)≈x2+2y
c
f(x,y)≈x2+y
d
f(x,y)≈16+2x+y
e
f(x,y)≈16+2x+y2
